vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: mma-bridge
Version: 1.1.0

The skill facilitates interaction with the 'Meteor Master AI' application via a CLI tool (mma-bridge) and involves high-risk operations such as executing PowerShell commands, reading from the system's temporary directory, and making local network requests to 127.0.0.1. While these actions are plausibly required for the skill's stated purpose, the use of shell execution and local networking, combined with the requirement to install a global npm package, meets the threshold for a suspicious classification. The instructions are found in SKILL.md and involve commands like 'mma check' and 'mma list'.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper for the mma-bridge CLI to talk to a local Meteor Master AI app; its requests and instructions are consistent with that purpose and do not ask for unrelated credentials or network access.

dimensions.detail: The name/description say it uses the mma-bridge CLI to interact with Meteor Master AI. The SKILL.md only references installing an npm CLI package, launching/checking a local app, reading temp/registry files, and calling localhost HTTP endpoints (port 9000). Those requirements are proportional and expected for a local-bridge CLI.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions tell the agent/operator to run mma commands that may execute PowerShell (to detect/launch the app), read the system temp registry directory, and call http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health. Those actions are within scope for managing a local app, but they do involve access to local system state (process/app list, temp files, and local network ports).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill is instruction-only and provides no automatic install. It tells users to globally install an npm package (npm install -g mma-bridge). Because installation is manual and no arbitrary downloads are embedded in the skill, the installation risk from the skill itself is low. Note: installing a global npm package is a separate trust decision — not performed by the skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The SKILL.md also does not request secrets or unrelated credentials. The only accesses are to local app state and localhost HTTP, which align with the described functionality.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled (always:false) and does not request persistent system-wide privileges or modify other skills' configuration. Autonomous model invocation is allowed by default but not a unique privilege here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is essentially documentation for using the mma-bridge CLI to talk to a local Meteor Master AI app. Before installing or running anything: (1) verify the mma-bridge npm package source and maintainer (npm packages execute code at install/run time), (2) confirm you intentionally want a tool that will probe your local system (app list, temp directory) and open localhost ports (default 9000), and (3) enable the MMABridge option in your Meteor Master AI app only if you trust the app and the bridge utility. If you need stronger assurance, inspect the mma-bridge package source code or install in a sandboxed environment first.
